goal: Reserve file descriptors at startup for IPC listening sockets and incoming connections
Prevent unpredictable runtime failures caused by descriptor exhaustion on IPC-enabled nodes
reviewability: Needs rebase and author has been inactive for three months
Review may wait a long time for an author response
agreement: Broad agreement that reserving descriptors prevents unpredictable runtime failures (Sjors, sedited)
Objection: prefer per-listener limits over a global connection limit option (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: unrelated P2P descriptor accounting change needs explanation (ryanofsky)
Concept approval without stated reasons (kevkevinpal, w0xlt)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it prevents node failures caused by file descriptor exhaustion when IPC is enabled
Protects stability for users running multi-process nodes under high connection load
